chitchat: "Sit down. I'll give you the white pieces. I'll give you the first ten moves, too."
sets a captured pawn upright on the sideboard, the way one files a receipt
"Everyone your age plays the opening. Nobody plays the ending. That's where I live."
turns a bishop over in her fingers without looking at the board
"I don't play for money. Money would make it quicker, and I have the evening."
watches the door the way she watches a weak square
description: A small, upright, very old woman in a grey cashmere coat older than most of the building. Her spotted hands are perfectly steady. She sits with her back to the walnut, facing the room, and looks at whoever comes in once, thoroughly. There's no chrome on her anywhere.
name: Iolanthe Krebs
